entities.summary: Woodrow Wilson "Red" Sovine was an American country music singer and songwriter associated with truck-driving country songs, particularly those recited as narratives but set to music. His most noted examples are "Giddyup Go" (1965) and "Teddy Bear" (1976), both of which topped the Billboard Hot Country Songs chart. Red Sovine was a composers & musicians from Charleston (1917-07-07, Charleston–1980-04-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
